design.motif: Giraffe browsing height: unmistakable delicate bipinnate acacia leaflets, one restrained curved seed pod and thin forked twigs. A high airy canopy from the upper right, with tiny leaflets visibly embossed at thumbnail size. No unrelated tropical leaves or blossoms.

description.en: Unmistakable delicate bipinnate acacia leaflets, one restrained curved seed pod and thin forked twigs.
description.zh: 纤细的金合欢复叶与弯曲豆荚落在枝头，像长颈鹿抬眼便能触及的一小片树冠。

design.rationale: The existing animal/bird identity determines a plausible broad botanical setting; no species claim is added. Product category does not override an approved animal identity.

description.en: A personal GitHub observatory for repositories, workflows, and encrypted snapshots.
description.zh: 个人 GitHub 观察台，集中查看仓库、工作流与加密的访问令牌快照。

purpose.en: Review repositories, open work, alerts, and daily changes across GitHub accounts in a personal console with on-demand data refreshes.
purpose.zh: 在个人控制台查看多个 GitHub 账号的仓库、待办、告警和每日变化，按需同步 GitHub 数据。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
